name: Example: Calculating a Minor in a 3x3 Matrix With Variable Entries
problem:
What is the minor of $c_{22}$ in the matrix
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14075201/assets/1449dfd139653f75de7be2e27e86f0c9d2d8a5a17e25ae184b892f489ffbb71e.png)
worked_solution:
First, we remove the second row and second column: 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14075201/assets/09bd73c7e51abcad8efa354317519a2687601b3ccdbfea0ac2b6222f75b3397e.png)

Next, we calculate the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det[\begin{aligned}7x & -3y \\ -y & 5\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}7x & -3y \\ -y & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =7x\cdot 5-(-3y)\cdot (-y) \\  & =35x-3{y}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
